paragraphs: LeagueLobster sells online scheduling software for sports leagues and tournaments. A round-robin fixture generator is offered at no cost for simple league schedules. Knockout brackets can be generated for each division, with or without consolation games, in single or double elimination.

Organizers can sign up teams and players and collect registration fees. The registration forms are customizable and take file uploads. A club landing page with a connected domain and added sub-pages is also part of the product.

Scheduling runs against constraints for teams, coaches, divisions and pools, with limits on games per day and time between games. Public schedule pages carry the organizer's own logo and color scheme and filter by division and team. Finished schedules export to CSV or Excel and can be embedded on the customer's own site.

quote.text: All the tools you need to run your league or tournament organization are right here.
